sentences.zh: 是在尖叫的时候还是其他时候？

sentences.zh: 因为她在这一段结尾的时候笑了一下。

sentences.zh: 说得好。

sentences.en: If you go to 14 minutes, 14 seconds, right after Kevin says the man tree puts its penis,

sentences.zh: 镜头切到了过肩镜头，你可以看到她的肩膀在颤抖。

sentences.zh: 我们都觉得那句台词特别好笑。

sentences.en: I remember doing that one.
sentences.zh: 我记得那场戏是我演的。

sentences.en: So Dwight has left.
sentences.zh: 所以德怀特离开了。

sentences.en: He's bailed.
sentences.zh: 他溜了。

sentences.zh: 现在他们正试图想办法怎么从他嘴里套出密码？

sentences.zh: 怎么让他停下这一切？

sentences.zh: 这需要安迪、帕姆、亚伦和凯文一起去施鲁特农场。

sentences.en: They come upon him and he is digging a giant hole.
sentences.zh: 他们找到他时，他正在挖一个巨大的坑。

sentences.zh: 原来那是给一匹马挖的坟墓。

sentences.en: How did you get through that?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么忍住没笑场的？

sentences.zh: 要是我的话，他一开口我就得笑喷了，

sentences.zh: 而且如果你撞到了什么东西，那多半是另一匹马。

sentences.en: It was so funny.
sentences.zh: 太搞笑了。

sentences.zh: 除了你们在屏幕上看到的那些，我们还得拍这个。

sentences.en: Pam says, oh, no, your horse died.
sentences.zh: 帕姆说，噢，不，你的马死了。

sentences.en: And Dwight said, no.
sentences.zh: 德怀特说，不。

sentences.zh: 如果你等着马自然死亡，那尸体得在那儿放好几天，让其他动物看见。

sentences.en: Once the animals know about death, it's all over.
sentences.zh: 一旦动物们知道了死亡这回事，一切就全完了。

sentences.zh: 我们当时根本拍不下去。

sentences.en: And another one was when Pam said, oh, no, your horse died.
sentences.zh: 还有一个版本是帕姆说，噢，不，你的马死了。

sentences.en: Dwight said, no, I'm trying to trap some horse grave robbers.
sentences.zh: 德怀特说，不，我是在设陷阱抓那些盗马贼。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: So he was digging a fake horse grave as a trap.
sentences.zh: 所以他是在挖一个假马坟作为陷阱。

sentences.en: Oh, my goodness.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Well, I'll tell you guys, we shot this out at Disney Ranch.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你们吧，我们是在迪士尼牧场拍的这场戏。

sentences.en: And we actually shot this the Friday before we shot Garden Party.
sentences.zh: 而且我们是在拍《花园派对》的前一个周五拍的这场戏。

sentences.en: And Steve Burgess says the reason the camera never really pans very far to the left of Dwight's farmhouse
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·伯吉斯说，摄像机之所以从来没有大幅度向德怀特农舍的左侧平移，

sentences.zh: 是因为他们当时已经开始为《花园派对》搭建帐篷了。

sentences.en: And we had to keep it out of frame.
sentences.zh: 我们必须得把它挡在镜头之外。

sentences.en: We had a very limited, like, shooting area because we were already in prep.
sentences.zh: 我们的拍摄区域非常有限，因为我们已经在做准备工作了。

sentences.en: Well, while you guys are all at Shroot Farms trying to talk Dwight into giving you the passcode,
sentences.zh: 好吧，当你们都在施鲁特农场试图说服德怀特告诉你们密码时，

sentences.zh: 吉姆被派去执行任务，要缠住罗伯特·加州，让他没空看手机，

sentences.en: so he doesn't notice if he gets emails, right, at 5 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 这样他就不会注意到五点钟有没有收到邮件了，对吧。

sentences.en: And the task is go play squash with Robert California.
sentences.zh: 任务就是去和罗伯特·加州打壁球。

sentences.en: Aaron is like he's somewhere either eating squash or playing squash.
sentences.zh: 亚伦说他要么是在吃壁球，要么是在打壁球。

sentences.en: So Jim is on the case.
sentences.zh: 所以吉姆接下了这个任务。

sentences.en: There was actually a deleted Jim talking head where he shares how much he knows about squash.
sentences.zh: 其实还有一段被删减的吉姆访谈，他在里面分享了自己对壁球的了解程度。

sentences.en: And I want you to hear it.
sentences.zh: 我想让你们听听。

sentences.en: I have never played squash, but I've seen it in countless 80s movies.
sentences.zh: 我从没打过壁球，但我看过无数部80年代的电影。

sentences.en: And it seems like the most common mistake is that you serve too hard and hit yourself right in the squash balls.
sentences.zh: 最常见的错误似乎就是发球太用力，结果直接打到了自己的壁球蛋蛋上。

sentences.en: So as long as I don't do that, I think I'll be all right.
sentences.zh: 所以只要我不犯那个错，我想我应该没问题。

sentences.en: That's a very funny talking head.
sentences.zh: 那段访谈太搞笑了。

sentences.en: That's all he knows about squash.
sentences.zh: 那就是他对壁球的所有了解了。

sentences.en: And when he arrives, he's actually ripping the tag off his racket.
sentences.zh: 当他到达时，他其实正在撕掉球拍上的标签。

sentences.en: He's clearly never played, although he tells Robert California, like, hey, I play all the time.
sentences.zh: 他显然从没打过，尽管他告诉罗伯特·加州说，嘿，我经常打。

sentences.en: It starts a very funny runner between the two of them.
sentences.zh: 这开启了他们两人之间一段非常有趣的连贯剧情。

sentences.zh: 噢，是吗？

sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.zh: 你和我当时没参与壁球那几天的拍摄。

sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Guess what we were doing.
sentences.zh: 猜猜我们在干什么。

sentences.en: I have no idea.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道。

sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.zh: 你给我发了邮件。

sentences.en: Hey, lady, if I'm not totally wrecked by shooting at Shrute Farms,
sentences.zh: 嘿，女士，如果我在舒鲁特农场拍摄时没被彻底折腾垮的话，

sentences.zh: 明天我们休息的时候，我会过去把你那里的摇篮拿走。

sentences.en: I can't wait to see you.
sentences.zh: 我迫不及待想见你了。

sentences.en: And maybe I can even see Isabel.
sentences.zh: 也许我还能见到伊莎贝尔。

sentences.en: Yes, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: You let me borrow this beautiful white wicker bassinet.
sentences.zh: 你借给了我这个漂亮的白色柳条摇篮。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Oh, I remember that.
sentences.zh: 哦，我记得那个。

sentences.en: I was so happy that someone else could use it because it was such a beautiful gift that I got when Isabel was born.
sentences.zh: 我当时很高兴有人能用上它，因为这是伊莎贝尔出生时我收到的非常精美的礼物。

sentences.en: Our family members went in together and bought us this beautiful white wicker bassinet,
sentences.zh: 我们的家人凑钱给我们买了这只漂亮的白色柳条摇篮，

sentences.en: the kind that, you know, you can, it has handles and you can take it off
sentences.zh: 那种，你知道的，它有把手，你可以把它取下来，

sentences.zh: 或者把它放在底座上，在屋子里推着走。

sentences.en: I remember that.
sentences.zh: 我记得那个。

sentences.en: We kept it up in our kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我们把它放在厨房里。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: It made me so happy.
sentences.zh: 它让我感到非常开心。

sentences.zh: 回到舒鲁特农场，大家都在帮德怀特挖马的坟墓。

sentences.en: And they're tired.
sentences.zh: 他们都累坏了。

sentences.en: And Pam asked if they can come inside for a little water.
sentences.zh: 帕姆问他们能不能进屋喝点水。

sentences.en: She's going to talk about how, oh, I forgot how pretty it was in here.

sentences.en: It's so lovely.

sentences.zh: 然后他们会坐下来。

sentences.zh: 他会给他们端上一些卷心菜派。

sentences.zh: 他们吃着派，闲聊着。

sentences.zh: 我不知道你有没有注意到，在德怀特的肩膀后面，有一段凯文从厨房走出来的戏，

sentences.zh: 你怎么可能没注意到凯文假装要用煎锅敲德怀特的头呢？

sentences.zh: 凯文，丹尼说他们给凯文的第一个煎锅是大家见过最大的煎锅。

sentences.zh: 他说直径大概有两英尺。

sentences.en: And that he and Troy were like, no, no, no, just a normal frying pan.
sentences.zh: 他和特洛伊当时就说，不，不，不，只要一个普通的煎锅就行。

sentences.en: And they had to switch it out.
sentences.zh: 于是他们不得不把它换掉。

sentences.zh: 关于这一点，我有两件事要分享。

sentences.zh: 首先，我想看看拍摄剧本里是怎么写的。

sentences.en: It said this.
sentences.zh: 上面是这么写的。

sentences.zh: 他把它举过德怀特的头顶，想要砸下去。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.zh: 凯文放下平底锅，重新回到桌边。

sentences.zh: 好吧，这让我很好奇凯文为什么要这么做。

sentences.en: Why is he acting so odd?
sentences.zh: 他为什么表现得这么奇怪？

sentences.zh: 你可能注意到了，凯文在舒鲁特农场时一句话也没说。

sentences.zh: 事实上，你会发现直到他们离开之后，在路上的时候，他才开口说话。

sentences.en: The whole entire time he's at Shroot Farms, he doesn't say a single word.
sentences.zh: 他在舒鲁特农场的整个过程中，一个字都没说。

sentences.en: There was a reason.
sentences.zh: 这是有原因的。

sentences.en: It's in deleted scenes.
sentences.zh: 在删减片段里有交代。

sentences.en: I want you to hear it.
sentences.zh: 我想让你听听看。

sentences.zh: 好了，伙计们，我想我要同时扮演坏警察和好警察了。

sentences.zh: 我要演得像个疯狂警察。

sentences.en: Dwight Shroot, come out here with your hands up.
sentences.zh: 德怀特·舒鲁特，举起手来，出来。

sentences.en: I'm so nervous.
sentences.zh: 我好紧张。

sentences.en: I feel like I'm going to say some.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我快要说漏嘴了。

sentences.zh: 凯文，我不会把这事搞砸的。

sentences.zh: 这是你们走向舒鲁特农场时的对白。

sentences.en: Kevin is having a meltdown.
sentences.zh: 凯文当时快崩溃了。

sentences.en: He doesn't know how to like coax Dwight or what to say.
sentences.zh: 他不知道该怎么哄德怀特，也不知道该说什么。

sentences.zh: 而你们就像是说，别说一个字。

sentences.en: Okay.

sentences.en: Nothing's working.

sentences.zh: 我去拿个平底锅。

sentences.zh: 那就是，po-buddy's nerfict（倒霉透顶）。

sentences.zh: 我记得丹尼当时说，不，我小时候门垫上就有这个。

sentences.zh: 那是他想到这个词的原因。
